in_hebrew.name: Fini
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fini הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Fini was a goddess of the end or conclusion of things. She was often depicted as a woman holding a torch or a key, symbolizing the end of a cycle and the beginning of a new one.
